text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services has been directed by North York Community Council to investigate and report back on the following proposed turning movement prohibitions during weekday peak periods at the following intersections: - eastbound left turns from Codsell Avenue onto Bathurst Street; - northbound right turns and southbound left turns onto Codsell Avenue from Wilmington Avenue; and - northbound right turns and southbound left turns onto Codsell Avenue from Wilson Heights Boulevard. The results of the assessment on Wilmington Avenue and Wilson Heights Boulevard indicate that the volume of turning traffic is low to moderate and there is no collision pattern associated with these movements. However,…

North York Community Council: 1. Approved the northbound right-turn and southbound left-turn prohibition from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, at the intersection of Codsell Avenue and Wilmington Avenue.
